notes: AI without the NVIDIA engine (DirectML): Breezy could close without a word in the middle of a task. Two things caused it and both are fixed. AI denoise is now loaded for the exact size of the pieces it works on, in pieces of 256 (it needs a lot of graphics memory this way). And two AI steps no longer use the graphics card at the very same moment - they take turns. With the NVIDIA engine, which your PC uses, nothing changes.
